'''EN-C7''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] stationed on the [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnought]] ''[[Ziost Shadow]]'' during the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[Tion Hegemony rakghoul outbreak|outbreak]] of the [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|rakghoul plague]] in the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]], they transported an Imperial strike team to [[Kaon]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
EN-C7 appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as an NPC on the ''Ziost Shadow'', who begins the flashpoint "Kaon Under Siege."
